name: claim-check
description: After each answer, a second model sorts its claims by what backs them (this turn's tool output, an earlier turn, memory, reasoning, nothing), with every cited quote checked in code

autoCorrect.title: Auto-correct contradictions
autoCorrect.description: Off by default. When on, a claim the evidence contradicts sends one correction prompt unasked (at most one per prompt of yours).

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: The model that checks each answer. sonnet is the default; haiku is faster and misses more; opus is slower and stricter. A model picked in the Mods panel wins over this.

timingLog.title: Timing log
timingLog.description: What is written to ~/.claude/claim-check-timings.jsonl (the last 200 lines are kept). summary: one line per check with its timings and verdict counts. stages: a line at each step too, to find where a check hangs. off: nothing.
